issues.title: Revenue Calculation
issues.problem: The query calculates total revenue but does not filter for 'COMPLETED' status in the SUM function.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue

issues.title: Column Naming
issues.problem: Column names are in uppercase which is less readable and not consistent with SQL naming conventions.

issues.title: Lack of Comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining the purpose and logic.
issues.fix:
-- Revenue by merchant
SELECT 
    dm.merchant_name,
    dm.category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(ft.TRANSACTION_ID) as transaction_count
FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft
INNER JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant dm ON ft.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id
WHERE ft.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY dm.merchant_name, dm.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

review.corrected_sql:
-- Revenue by merchant
SELECT 
    dm.merchant_name,
    dm.category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(ft.TRANSACTION_ID) as transaction_count
FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft
INNER JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant dm ON ft.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id
WHERE ft.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY dm.merchant_name, dm.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
review.summary: The query calculates revenue correctly but has readability issues and a minor correctness issue in the revenue calculation. The corrected query includes proper case sensitivity and comments for readability.
